goal: Add an example TypeScript frontend and Go backend endpoint with tests
instructions: Prefer minimal changes; do not change unrelated files or credentials.

nodes.intent: Frontend and backend run in parallel, so they need one agreed contract before either starts.
done_when: docs/feature-plan.md names the endpoint path, request and response shape
nodes.prompt: Write a short change plan to docs/feature-plan.md. Do not modify application files.

nodes.intent: Users reach the feature through the web client.
done_when: The client calls the endpoint as specified in the plan
TypeScript tests cover the new call
assumptions: The backend follows the contract in docs/feature-plan.md
nodes.prompt: Implement the frontend part of docs/feature-plan.md and update related TypeScript tests.

nodes.intent: The endpoint is the source of truth the client depends on.
done_when: The endpoint matches the contract in the plan
Go tests cover success and invalid input
nodes.prompt: Implement the Go backend part of docs/feature-plan.md and update related tests.

nodes.intent: Two hosts built the halves separately; an independent read catches contract mismatches.
nodes.prompt: Review the final diff and report defects. Compare results; do not edit files.
